note: Machine numbers for the factory gates. Every group has a 'src' (the rule that fixes the number). Precedence: Jake rulings > RULEBOOK > TECHNIQUES > rest; when this file disagrees with RULEBOOK.md, the RULEBOOK wins and this file is the bug.

structure.src: REFERENCE-BASELINE §1a/§1b + rubric D7; RULEBOOK P4; Jake R14 P5 (2026-10-10: 'Have screencasts a little bit longer (slower pace a little bit) automatically') — spans x1.2, share +3-4 points, boundaries /1.2; A-roll beats unchanged; the narration is never cut or sped up (only the picture holds longer)
structure.near_miss_src: Jake R14 D: a share within +-3 points of the band is fixed by code (spans extended/shortened at sentence edges), never held

pace.src: Jake R14 P5 (2026-10-10): screencasts a little longer / slower paced, automatically: +20 % (inside the asked +15-25 %) on holds after each beat and on camera move durations (the reference easing curves unchanged); still-frame cap stays 3 s (constant motion, RULEBOOK P1)

aroll.src: RULEBOOK A1/A2/T5/T6 (TR07); M1 conflicts with A2 (reviewer to re-confirm), A2 wins until then

narration.src: RULEBOOK R11 (Jake 2026-10-09: 'G1 trims pauses - I don't want that at all'); edl.LONG_PAUSE_KEEP

screen_reference.src: RULEBOOK R13 / C8 (Jake 2026-10-09): every sentence in which the narrator shows or refers to something on screen is a screencast (hand-off: a slot) — never full-screen A-roll. aieditor/screenref.py reads this group; the plan check enforces it (error code screen_ref).
screen_reference.note: case-insensitive regexes over ONE sentence's words (planfit.sentences); a sentence the presenter_re skips (his own calls to action / sign-off) is never flagged

caps.src: Jake: $20 per rolling 24 h server cap (cloud.py daily_cap_usd); recommendation §5 + Jake decision 1 (api_daily pending)
caps.onboarding_src: Jake 2026-10-09 decision 4: OK, but try to keep a new app's onboarding under $10; Jake R14 P2 (2026-10-10): per app PER VIDEO (every video onboards its own playbook)
caps.api_job_src: Jake R14 P2 (2026-10-10): creative $8 -> $17.50 = the $8 the rest of a creative job needs + the per-video onboarding <= $9.50 (onboarding_app_usd)

onboarding.src: Jake R14 P2/P3/P4 (2026-10-10): every missing action is explored, recorded and proven off camera for THIS video (job/preprod/playbook-<app>.json); the shared playbook is only the starting hint and is never written back
onboarding.old_chats: never opened or changed: exploration and proofs run in fresh chats or chats this job created

producer.src: Jake 2026-10-10: assets are made in the app's UI (no image API key) by a producer agent that finds the route itself (aieditor/producer.py); limits enforced in code (genledger.py)
producer.daily_generations_src: Jake 2026-10-10: 'when the message appear in ChatGPT it will be the daily cap' — no own cap; the app's limit/wall message stops every generation (genledger block) and the job waits

ship.src: rubric.md ship rule; recommendation §4 (Jake decision 2, 2026-10-09: 0.80; a held video is not published)

motion_templates.enabled_src: OFF until Jake approves the preview pack (coordinator 2026-10-09: 'show me the final motion design templates before we add them into the auto editor')

motion_templates.anywhere_src: Jake 2026-10-14: "I would like to add them if they are relevant in a video" + "I'm ok with 2 per video" — the overlay templates may sit anywhere a line fits (hook or body), still at most max_per_video, never over a screencast, their own budget (not the overlay / plate budgets). prompt_result (MO05) stays the hook construct (hook_s).

rehearsal.src: Jake 2026-10-11: 'the agent finds the way to do the screencast and writes the code to present the screencast in the best way' + 'just the pure flow of what needs to be recorded — after he got to that answer' (aieditor/rehearse.py). Agents act OFF camera, code records.
rehearsal.mode_src: agent = the rehearsal agent writes each screencast's script (default); playbook = the old compiled playbook path. Env AIEDITOR_REHEARSAL=agent|playbook overrides.
rehearsal.caps_src: a Sonnet turn (screenshot + element list) ~ $0.02-0.03, an Opus turn ~ $0.05: 25 turns + the distill call fit $0.75; ~35 screencasts a video at a typical ~$0.20 fit $8

assets_agent.src: Jake 2026-10-11: 'Getting the pictures right — should only be made by an agent not by code' (aieditor/assetagent.py; the same switch as rehearsal.mode). The verifier (vision fidelity + preflight.audit_asset) rejects → another try; after the cap the asset is needs_asset.
assets_agent.caps_src: a picture: up to 4 tries x 12 Sonnet turns, capped at $1.50 of agent + check calls; the onboarding_app_usd cap still applies on top
